title: Runescape: Dragonwilds | 7:01 Kuldra | 1.0.1/1.0.1.1 Legacy WR
author: Nano
description:
Windstepping up the blocks to Kuldra no longer works as of 1.0.1.2/1.0.1.3. You can still get up to that area via just flying lmao. Plunge-cancel tech has evolved even further, check out @Dotxygaming's video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GeWbo4GpFEg

@texaspete.2173 has posted a sub 7! It's a great run but it is using some strats that have been patched at this point. Still it's worth a watch of course! Clean run and using some different movement from me, so many things to learn.

Thanks to @SectorTSWG via @Sir_Rebral for the new skip to Fragments, and @notmusty1 via @IINo1goodII for finding a lovely hole in Keep!
Thanks again to @Dotxygaming for the plunge-cancel tech, it's very fun.

Run Notes:
There's still a good amount of time to save here, clearly can be done sub 7 judging by my sum of best, but needs very clean movement and strong zoops. Especially in the area with the 3rd BD directly after zooping from keep, if you get a strong enough one you can make it all the way from where you landed to well past the plant.

Run's Verified on SRC for those that care: 
https://www.speedrun.com/Runescape_Dragonwilds/runs/m74v4p4m

Consider joining the RSDW Speedrunning Discord for more!
https://discord.gg/aGZkuC5yK6

comments.author: @iNanobit
comments.text:
How to save time and some general tips:

0:23 Tapped sprint in beginning but was already sprinting, so walked in beginning for about 1.5s before re-sprinting
0:51 Can do 4 air dash instead of 3 towards 1st air anima pillar
1:14 Can do 3 air dash instead of 2 towards 2nd air anima pillar
1:22 KB from Kuldra initial hit can be iframed with better timed dash + tighter line over torch into 1st BD
1:30 Earth Pillar can be started about 1s earlier, can see camera shake of frustration 🤣
1:39 Falling down after 1st BD can take slightly better line to jump off point
1:45 Technically could start zoop to Fragments about 1.5s earlier but this zoop is hard, so safety.
2:05 Zoop from keep wall across pond can make it all the way to the gate with a good one, save maybe 2.5s
2:13 Can likely plunge cancel here on John Goblikon ( https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=ahT3UrbOn0c ) instead of waiting to fall, saving a second maybe.
2:28 More confidence pushing into the hole will produce better (faster) results.
2:32 With a good zoop here you can make it all the way to where I'm standing at 2:37, with no air/phase dash at all.
2:45 Not exactly a time save but it's important to start surging from exactly where I do, so the demon doesn't chase you into the next area. I've seen him come inside and fight me alongside the thane. 💀
2:47 Don't hit this pillar lmao. Skele blocked my path here and I tried to adjust, poorly.
3:22 Extra swing, not ideal. Don't forget to re-use your fleet-footed infusion here, because I did.
3:46 This zoop can go far enough to require no dashes.
3:50 This zoop can go far enough to place you around where I'm standing at 3:57. This saves A LOT of time if it works.
4:38 Again not exactly a time save, but it's a nice point of reference of where to jump from, into the OOB.
4:44 Extra jump up onto the rock here not needed, just missed the first one.
5:07 You could probably plunge cancel here to save a small amount of time, but remember that DScim doesn't have a plunge animation, so you need something else equipped.
5:12 Same here, as well as using the cancel to dash onto the first rock that I jump from at 5:15.
5:18 Sometimes this zoop is strong enough to only need 1 dash, then you can save the phase dash for Kuldra.
5:33 If you're incredibly lucky, or smart enough to figure out the exact position to jump from and hit into, you can clip straight through the ground at rib clip, without having to crouch walk up it and scimmy swing to clip out. This saves at least 3s.
5:52 You can probably air dash at least twice here (don't waste phase dash yet though) and retain enough stamina to make the next jump here.
5:57 With a strong enough zoop you don't need an air or phase dash.
6:16 Not really a timesave but make sure you stay to the RIGHT of the small white floating cube you can see where the bridge would normally be, or you will bonk and fall. If you managed to save 1 of 2 possible phase dashes earlier, you can use one here for safety.

comments.author: @iNanobit
comments.text:
This is the plunge-cancel tech that Dotxy found! If you start a plunge attack near the peak of a windstep, then use any AOE spell (in this case i'm pressing Q1 for Magical Mending), then immediately cancel, you can gain additional movement in the air (1 more jump, and a dash and/or phase dash).

TL;DR: Windjump -> Attack -> AoE spell -> Cancel -> Extra Movement

I am playing on PC, but I'm not using any mods, that would defeat the purpose of the run, and be obviously unfair! This movement tech might be harder to do on console but it's not necessary for any skip, it just makes it a bit faster in a couple places.

comments.author: @iNanobit
comments.text:
I should note btw, that the zoop from Vines to Fragments is relatively precise, at least in my experience, but it could just be skill issue. At least half of my runs died here. You need to use it either on the frame you start walking off the rock (it's got an incredibly small slope after the flat part, before it drops off completely), or 1 before. Any earlier and you smash your ankles into the side Fragments and fall to your death, any later and it becomes an air dash. I haven't found any difference between walking and running, besides that walking allows more time to react, which could lead to an illusion of walking making you go farther. I think lower framerates can give better zoops as well, just from random observations, but I can't/haven't really tested that.

That said if you want an easier (but slower) skip to Fragments I suggest checking out my Day 1 Strats Video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vw_Mr5TGJAg for the zoop from necro island into respawn skip.
